verdict.rationale: Okta's docs show event-driven mechanisms (event hooks that fire on org events) and SCIM-based app provisioning that could underlie lifecycle automation, but nothing in the evidence describes Okta's actual no-code Workflows builder or hire/role-change/departure-specific triggers and app-by-app orchestration UI that IT admins configure without code. missing for 10: mention of Okta Workflows no-code builder, explicit hire/role-change/departure triggers, drag-and-drop app-by-app choreography, and any hands-on/community corroboration of it working.
